cloudflareRotation.production: The maintainer re-issued the production Cloudflare deploy credential as a new one at the minimum scope (Workers Scripts and Pages on the account, Workers Routes on the xivdyetools.app zone, no KV, D1 or R2), which closes 2026-08-29 audit FINDING-030, and revoked the old one after the test runs.

cloudflareRotation.notExercised: None of the three runs deploys Pages, so the new production credential's Pages grant is unused. No Deploy Web App, Deploy Discord Worker or Deploy Moderation Worker run has started since 2026-11-02 (run list read 2026-11-13).

cloudflareRotation.discordCredentials: Deferred in OPEN_ITEMS.md to after the M line's deploys have finished green, because both bot deploys register commands with their GitHub copy.
cloudflareRotation.consequence: The first use of the new Pages grant is the first approved Deploy Web App run, whichever that is. Each of #427, #431, #433, #434 and #432 starts one; none is approved. M-DISCORD's and M-MODERATION's selected runs are the first approved runs of those two workflows under the new credential: no independent matches their path filters. The AP-24(i) acceptance rests on runs made before the rotation.
